import sys, itertools, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import brute
from brute import trees, flatten, weights, WIDTH, LANES

def old_options(starts, bursts, costs):
    hit,miss,decode=costs
    R=len(starts); W=weights(starts,bursts)
    out={}
    for tree in trees(0,R,{}):
        nodes=flatten(tree); n=len(nodes)
        for modes in itertools.product(range(3),repeat=n):
            ok=True; info=[]
            for idx,(lo,span,kids) in enumerate(nodes):
                mode=modes[idx]
                spread=starts[lo+span-1]-starts[lo]
                if mode==1 and spread>=(1<<64): ok=False;break
                if mode==2 and spread>=(1<<32): ok=False;break
                arity=len(kids); keys=arity-1 if arity else span
                used=32+(4*arity if arity else 0)+keys*WIDTH[mode]
                P=(used+63)//64
                q,t=W[(lo,lo+span)]; lanes=LANES[mode]
                unc=P*miss*t + ((keys+lanes-1)//lanes+decode[mode])*q
                gain=P*(miss-hit)*t
                info.append((P,unc,gain))
            if not ok: continue
            total=sum(P for P,_,_ in info)
            for cached in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=n):
                w=0; used=0
                for (P,unc,gain),c in zip(info,cached):
                    w += unc-gain if c else unc
                    used += P if c else 0
                if used>12: continue
                cand=(w,total+1+(4*R+63)//64)
                cur=out.get(used)
                if cur is None or cand<cur: out[used]=cand
    return out

rng=random.Random(9)
for trial in range(20):
    R=rng.randint(1,4)
    starts=sorted(rng.sample(range(0,1<<30),R))
    bursts=[(rng.randint(1,5), [rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(rng.randint(0,3))]) for _ in range(rng.randint(0,2))]
    costs=(rng.randint(1,3), rng.randint(3,12), [rng.randint(0,2) for _ in range(3)])
    a=old_options(starts,bursts,costs)
    b=brute.version_options(starts,None,bursts,costs)
    assert a==b, (trial,a,b)
print('per-version option tables agree')
